description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Notify the Ports and Airports Development Levy
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the amendment of regulatory rates and exemptions under the Ports and Airports Development Levy Act, No. 18 of 2011. It contains detailed schedules of tariff codes and concessionary rates, which constitutes a regulatory framework modification. While a minister is named, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers to issue a legal/regulatory order, not a personnel appointment or detailed portfolio assignment. The core content is about legal/regulatory changes to import levies and exemptions, fitting Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes).
